Aurora

the Witch Between Worlds
Mid laneTop lane

Aurora is a slippery spirit mage who hops in and out of fights. She curses enemies with her Q, leaps into invisibility with W, and blasts and hops back with E. Her ultimate traps enemies in a zone she can teleport across. Pick her if you like outplaying people with movement.

When to pick Aurora

✓ Safe blind pick

Mostly. Her hops and invisibility keep her safe into most lanes, but avoid blind picking her into the few counters if your team has a last pick for mid.

Pick into

  • Immobile scaling mages, like Ryze and Orianna, that she can trade with and roam away from
  • Melee divers and skirmishers who get trapped in her ultimate zone, like Irelia or Yasuo
  • Teams that chase hard: E hop and W invisibility make them waste their engage
  • Grouped teams she can trap with Between Worlds

Avoid into

  • Long-range poke she can't reach, like Zoe
  • Burst assassins who kill her while W is down, like LeBlanc and Katarina
  • Teams with lots of point-and-click crowd control that stops her hops

Great teammates

SejuaniSejuani's engage starts fights inside Aurora's ultimate zone.
RellRell pulls enemies together so Aurora's ultimate traps more of them.
ViVi locks a target down so Aurora's Q curses always land.

Your team needs: Pick Aurora when your team can start fights, so she can follow up with her ultimate zone and hop around the edges.

How to read the enemy team → · Practice drafting →

Strengths

  • Lots of movement: W leap with invisibility, E hop back, R leap
  • Strong short trades with Q recast plus E
  • Her ultimate zone is great at trapping groups and escaping
  • Heals from spirits she collects, so she can stay in lane

Weaknesses

  • Her abilities have a clear rhythm; if you misuse the hops you're exposed
  • Short range compared to long-range mages
  • Needs to hit Q to get full value from her combos
  • Vulnerable to hard crowd control when her W is down

Power spikes

  • Level 3: full combo with W lets you take aggressive trades.
  • Level 6: Between Worlds makes all-ins and escapes much stronger.
  • First item (Stormsurge): a big burst spike that helps finish kills.
  • Rabadon's Deathcap (third item): your damage jumps; one full combo can kill squishies.

Top tips

  • Hit Q, then recast it when the missile path lines up a second hit.
  • End trades with E so you hop away from danger.
  • W's invisibility lets you move through the river unseen. Use it to roam.
  • Your R zone lets you teleport across its edges. Use it to escape over a wall or out of a gank.
  • Your passive heals you, so short trades are good for you in lane.
  • Save W for dodging a hook, a stun or a big skill shot.
